notes.title: When Lore Yells — Goblin Vibes.
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]Our little goblin doesn’t care about ancient prophecies or serious lore drops — he’s too busy *vibing* while the Dark Mage yells about “The Truth”.[/p][p]Today we’re sharing a fresh meme from the dev build — a tiny peek into what happens when your main hero just wants to dance in the mud instead of read scrolls.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45641512/ad8147a585b02661e08feeedb829b9ce0da0321e.png"][/img][/p][p]⚡ What’s next?[/p][p]- Final boss fight with the Dark Mage ✔️[/p][p]- Portals, mushrooms and post-irony ✔️[/p][p]- More nonsense ✔️[/p][p]If you like chaotic goblins, portals and rebellious nonsense — hit that wishlist and come vibe with us:  [/p][p]👉 
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775190/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay weird, stay free from lore![/p][p]— The dev team 🧙‍♂️✨[/p][p]
[/p]
